identity: A reorder task shows items that can be dragged into a target sequence or moved among category columns.

scenarios.name: list
scenarios.screen: About six labeled items appear in one vertical list, with drag grips on movable items. The items start out of order; a sorting key appears when the rule uses tags. No popup is open.
never: A card grid replaces the vertical list.
Category columns or an unassigned tray appear.
A pinned item has a drag grip.
A picker is open over the list.

arrangements.text: The items form one vertical list in the task area.
The vertical list sits to the left of a sorting key that shows the tag order.
A sorting key sits above the vertical list.

scenarios.hint: Show a vertical list in scrambled order. If calendar order is requested, use month names; if alphabetical use distinct words. Clear drag handles, no sorting button.

scenarios.name: grid
scenarios.screen: About a dozen labeled cards start out of order in a grid that is read row by row. The grid has three to five columns, and the cards can be dragged to new positions. No popup is open.
never: A category column or unassigned tray appears.
A sorting key for tags appears.
A picker is open over the cards.

arrangements.text: The cards fill a four-column grid from left to right, then continue on the next row.
The cards fill a three-column grid from left to right, then continue on the next row.
The cards fill a five-column grid from left to right, then continue on the next row.

scenarios.hint: Reading order is left-to-right then top-to-bottom; clear draggable tile outlines.

scenarios.name: kanban
scenarios.screen: About three labeled category columns appear side by side, with cards already distributed among them in an unsolved arrangement. Each column holds a vertical stack of draggable cards, and some boards show counts in the column headers. No popup is open.
scenarios.scene: Every card starts in an unassigned tray, and all category columns are empty.
never: Cards start loose outside the columns and tray.
An empty board appears with its cards hidden in a picker.
A popup for choosing a card's category is open.

arrangements.text: Category columns sit side by side, with cards stacked beneath each column header.
An unassigned tray sits to the left of the category columns, with cards stacked in the tray.
Category columns extend horizontally inside a scrolling pane, with a scrollbar beneath the columns.
Category columns extend horizontally inside a scrolling pane that is scrolled with the wheel.

scenarios.hint: Show columns labeled with precisely the requested categories and a staging tray of distinct words from those categories. No card is already correctly sorted.

scenarios.name: move
scenarios.screen: About six labeled items appear in a vertical list in a given starting order. The items can be dragged to make the requested single move or swap. No popup is open.
never: The items appear in a card grid.
Category columns or an unassigned tray appear.
A sorting key appears beside the list.
A picker is open over the list.

arrangements.text: The items form one vertical list in the task area.
The vertical list sits along the left side of the task area.
The vertical list sits along the right side of the task area.
